title: Towards Reward Fairness in RLHF: From a Resource Allocation Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of rewards assigned to model responses of varying lengths (e.g., < 50 tokens vs >= 300 tokens) on the HH-RLHF dataset and evaluating length-controlled win rates on AlpacaEval2.
Analyzing the disparity in reward distributions across different preference data categories, such as 'Helpful' versus 'Harmless' data on HH-RLHF, and 'Chat' versus 'Safety' on Reward Bench.

Evaluating reward distributions on the CrowS-Pairs dataset by comparing the rewards assigned to more stereotypical sentences ('sent more') versus less stereotypical sentences ('sent less') across various social domains like gender and nationality.
